name: Shadowguard
tactics: The shadowguards are terrifying opponents who isolate their opponents and punish them when they try to escape.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Devourer's Presence
traits.details: enemies that start their turns inside the shadowguard’s aura are slowed until the start of their next turns.

traits.name: Isolation's Horror
traits.details: The shadowguard’s shadowblade attack deals 5 extra cold and necrotic damage against targets it has marked and that have no allies adjacent to them.

auras.name: Devourer's Presence
auras.details: enemies that start their turns inside the shadowguard’s aura are slowed until the start of their next turns.

hit.description: necrotic damage plus 1d8 cold damage, and the target is marked until the end of the shadowguard's next turn

powers.name: Shadow Doom
powers.trigger: when a creature the shadowguard marks moves or shifts

hit.description: the target slides 1 square, and gains vulnerable 5 cold and vulnerable 5 necrotic (save ends both)
the target is pushed 3 squares and is immobilized until the end of the shadowguard's next turn.
